about_the_game:
Even more animations for your RPG! This sequel to Wizard Widgets has mysterious animated magic wands, dramatic candle displays, huge crystal orbs and more!


The Wizard Widgets Animation Pack #2 Includes:

* Huge candlestick stand (9 colors, left and right facing, silver and gold bases)
* Giant crystal ball (9 colors, silver and gold bases, multiple animation patterns)
* Faberge Egg Door (9 colors, silver and gold bases, multiple animations)
* Fairy Lanterns (2 styles [orb and crystal], 9 colors, silver and gold bases)
* Glowing Jar (9 colors)
* Magical Platform (glowing animations, 9 colors, silver and gold bases)
* Magical Sword (9 colors, multiple animations)
* Magical Table (multiple animations, 9 colors, silver and gold bases)
* Obelisk (multiple animations, 9 colors, silver and gold bases)
* Pod (multiple animations, 9 colors, silver and gold bases)
* Magic Wand (multiple animations, 9 colors, silver and gold bases)
* 2000+ animations total!


Terms of Use:

This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.
OK to be used in Commercial projects
Contents can be edited
OK for use in games with gore
OK for use in adult-rated games
